summary: The app replay browser e2e collects the conversation pane's module response with a listener (scripts/response-wait.mjs) and bounds the wait only after the agent click, so a slow host can no longer make an early waitForResponse reject with no handler and kill the whole run. A new lane, Replay response wait, unit-tests the helper with mock timers

replay.detail: Test-script change only; no claim or projection replay.

schema.detail: No table, file or schema change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, retention or digest change.

compatibility.detail: No runtime, client, wire or harness change; apps/fractal-web/scripts/replay-e2e.mjs, the new response-wait helper and its node test, and one lane in scripts/ci-fractal-web.
